entities.summary: Wolfgang Robert Karl Adolf Ludwig Ferdinand Maria Dorasil was an ethnic German ice hockey player originating from Czechoslovakia. He played domestically for Troppauer EV, a German club based in Opava. Internationally, Dorasil represented Czechoslovakia in both the World and European Championships and also took part in the men's ice hockey tournament at the 1928 Winter Olympics.
